THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
THE NEW UNIFORM
058
81 / Camel Tailoring
Brown Suiting
A sharply cut camel-brown blazer with peaked lapels, worn open
over a matching pair of tailored shorts, a striped button-up shirt
and a fitted ribbed cardigan in a soft pink. Long, glossy black hair
falls around the shoulders, and oversized glasses frame a steady
gaze in front of a soft grey studio backdrop.
82 / Pleat Sport
Sporty Preppy
A sporty look in a white long-sleeve zip-neck top with a navy
collar, a pale sky-blue pleated mini skirt and bright blue ribbed
knee socks. Chunky white loafers, a white padded headband and
a green practice basket with golf club complete the outfit against
a pale railing and a beige wall.
